attestations.text: LI Kuang-ti 李光地 (T. 晉卿, H. 厚庵), Sept. 29, 1642–1718, June 26, official, was a native of An-hsi, Fukien. He was born in a scholarly family of moderate means which became impoverished in the course of the wars and lawlessness of the early Ch'ing period.
李光地，字晉卿，福建安溪人。

westernYears.note: Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.
Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.

accounts.evidence: 李光地，字晉卿，福建安溪人。幼穎異。年十三，舉家陷山賊中，得脫歸。力學慕古。康熙九年成進士，選庶吉士，授編修。十二年，乞省親歸。
